caption_L1: This area graph is labeled Median hourly earnings for full-time employees in the United Kingdom from 2004 to 2020 , by age group (in GBP). The x-axis plots Year as linear scale of range 2005 to 2015 while the y-axis measures 16 to 17 with linear scale of range 0 to 5.
